WITH base AS (
  SELECT ua.date, ua.router_model_id, ua.issue_roll, COUNT(*) AS attempts
  FROM cpe_update_attempt ua
  GROUP BY 1,2,3
), issues AS (
  SELECT ua.date, ua.router_model_id, COUNT(*) AS issues
  FROM cpe_issue ci
  JOIN cpe_update_attempt ua ON ci.update_attempt_id = ua.id
  GROUP BY 1,2
), agg AS (
  SELECT date, router_model_id,
         SUM(attempts) AS attempts,
         SUM(CASE WHEN issue_roll THEN attempts ELSE 0 END) AS rollout_attempts
  FROM base
  GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT a.date, a.router_model_id,
       attempts,
       ROUND(COALESCE(i.issues,0)*100.0/attempts,2) AS issues_per_100,
       ROUND(rollout_attempts*100.0/attempts,1) AS rollout_pct
FROM agg a
LEFT JOIN issues i USING (date, router_model_id)
ORDER BY date, router_model_id
LIMIT 200
